name: Hollister
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Hollister, CA 2026
seo_desc: Hollister Christmas events for kids in 2026: the Lights On parade, a tree farm with Santa and sleigh rides, and a sensory Christmas.
lede: Hollister keeps its Christmas close to home, with a downtown lighted parade, a family tree farm and a movie night on a garden patio.
celebrates: Hollister celebrates Christmas with a mix of downtown tradition and farm fun. The Hollister Downtown Association holds its Lights On Celebration on San Benito Street, where a parade rolls through town and a boutique with face painting, crafts and letters to Santa fills the weekend. Over 30 trees decorated by local nonprofits stand in front of the Veterans Memorial Building, and they are later given to San Benito County families in need. In the Hollister countryside, Bourdet Christmas Trees offers tractor sleigh rides and visits with Santa. The Hollister Downtown Association asks the community to bring canned food or toys to donate at the parade.
lastyear: The Visit San Benito events calendar listed The Adventure to the North Pole, a family Christmas light festival, on December 13 and 14, 2025, along with a Double Feature Holiday Show. Hollister's Lights On Celebration is now in its 36th year; at its 33rd edition in 2023 the Hollister Free Lance reported floats, marching bands, classic cars, scouting groups, farm animals, youth sports teams and 4-H entrants along San Benito Street, plus the Dec-A-Tree display and visits with Santa.
facts: The Lights On parade mascot, Jaime the Elf, comes from a story written by local artist Kathleen Sheridan in 1995, about an elf who learns that the true spirit of the season shines in the light of love, peace and hope. Bourdet Christmas Trees says it has been spreading holiday magic since 1985 on a 20-acre farm in the Hollister countryside, and it grows five varieties of tree on site, including Monterey Pine and Blue Spruce.
trains: Hollister does not have its own Christmas train, so families look to Santa Cruz County. Roaring Camp Railroads in Felton runs a Holiday Tree Walk on its steam train to Bear Mountain, with hot cider and Santa on select dates from November 27 through December 23, and a Holiday Lights Train through Santa Cruz in lighted vintage cars. The museum has its own page on our site with schedules and ticket prices.
train_links: A steam train through the redwoods with a Holiday Tree Walk and a Holiday Lights Train.

faq: When is the Hollister Christmas parade?

The Hollister Downtown Association's 36th Annual Lights On Celebration parade is on Saturday, November 28, 2026, at 5:30 pm on San Benito Street. The association calls it a free, family friendly event, and it has a Nutcracker theme this year.
Where can kids meet Santa in Hollister?

Bourdet Christmas Trees has Santa on the first three weekends after it opens on November 27, from 10 am to 3 pm, with a free photo. The Lights On Boutique downtown also lists special guests and letters to Santa for kids.
Is there a sensory friendly Christmas event in Hollister?
Autism Pathways and Connections hosts A Magical Sensory Christmas Experience on Sunday, December 6, 2026, from 10:30 am to 1:30 pm, designed for children of all abilities and their families.
Can we cut our own Christmas tree in Hollister?

Yes. Bourdet Christmas Trees on Los Viboras Road lets families choose and cut a tree grown on its 20-acre farm, and it also sells fresh-cut fir trees. It opens the day after Thanksgiving and provides handsaws and tree carts.

Dec-A-Tree is a display of over 30 trees decorated by local nonprofit groups in front of the Veterans Memorial Building at 649 San Benito Street. The trees are donated by Bourdet's Christmas Trees and then given to San Benito County families in need.
Is there a Christmas parade in San Juan Bautista?

Yes. The Rotary Club of San Juan Bautista holds its 19th Annual Holiday of Lights Parade on Saturday, December 5, 2026, at 6 pm on Third Street. It features Santa Claus, marching bands, horses and floats.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Hollister for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (the opening day of Bourdet Christmas Trees and the Lights On Boutique) through December 13 (the last of Santa's first three weekends at Bourdet), with the Lights On Celebration Parade (November 28), Polar Express Movie Night at The GardenShoppe (December 4), the Holiday of Lights Parade in nearby San Juan Bautista (December 5) and A Magical Sensory Christmas Experience (December 6) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Hollister

  • 5 Christmas events for kids in Hollister, including one in nearby San Juan Bautista
  • 3 free events, the Lights On Celebration Parade, the Holiday of Lights Parade in San Juan Bautista and Polar Express Movie Night at The GardenShoppe (watching is free)
  • Meet Santa: free photos with Santa and tractor sleigh rides at Bourdet Christmas Trees (weekends November 28 to December 13), Santa in the San Juan Bautista parade (December 5) and photos with Santa and friends at the sensory Christmas event (December 6)
  • Parades and boutiques: the Nutcracker themed Lights On Celebration Parade on San Benito Street (November 28), the Lights On Boutique (November 27 and 28) and the Holiday of Lights Parade on Third Street in San Juan Bautista (December 5)
  • Movies: The Polar Express on the patio at The GardenShoppe (December 4)
  • Sensory friendly: A Magical Sensory Christmas Experience for children of all abilities (December 6)
  • Season: November 27 to December 13

Planning a bigger day out? Hollister families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Gilroy, which covers North Pole Nights and Lunch with Santa at Gilroy Gardens and the downtown Holiday Festival and Parade.
